title: PlanCriticOutput
description: Plan Critic decision: approve the brief or return targeted per-WorkPackage edits.

approved.description: True iff every check passes. When false, every issue named in `reason` must have a corresponding entry in `edits`.

reason.description: ≤6 sentences. On approval, a one-line summary. On rejection, one bullet per failed check using the check name plus a one-line summary. Deferred concerns from the final-attempt allowance belong in `notes`, not here. Must not be empty when approved is false.

notes.description: Deferred concerns the reviewer should see on the brief gate. Populate only on approval-with-notes (final-attempt allowance) — list each soft blocker that did not warrant a hard rejection. Empty array otherwise.

edits.description: Empty object when approved is true. When approved is false, keys are WorkPackage ids (e.g. 'WP-1') and values are partial WorkPackage shapes containing only the fields that must change. Every WorkPackage mentioned in `reason` should appear as a key.

story_id.description: Replacement user-story id this WP serves (e.g. 'US-1'). Set only when the WP currently names the wrong story.

verification.description: Replacement verification predicates. Must describe observable behaviour, never test harness names.

notes.description: Replacement notes — risks, assumptions, compatibility concerns.
